summary: Computer Science student specializing in Backend Development, Python, Flask, Cloud Infrastructure, and Application Security with hands-on experience in vulnerability research, CTF infrastructure, and full-stack projects.

education.institution: SVKM’s Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering

description: Built a Python script to automate decompiling Android APKs with JADX and removing unwanted files before analysis.
Ran Semgrep with OWASP rules on decompiled code to find bugs across 30+ Android apps, reporting findings to platforms.
Built a compiled-regex scanner to detect hardcoded credentials and secret leaks before deployment packaging.
Documented and reported a credential leak found in a production college app; recognized by the college and assisted them in mitigating the bug.
Led a team of 6 to collaborate on designing and developing challenges for annual national CTF.
Led infrastructure for BreachBytes 3.0 (300+ participants), provisioning AWS EC2, configuring security groups for access control/port forwarding, and deploying live platform.
Coordinated security reviews, pre-event hardening, and deployment; trained 60+ juniors in cybersecurity through bootcamps.

projects.title: TruePrice
description: Built a Chrome/Brave/Edge extension in client-side JavaScript that captures Amazon prices and syncs them to a Flask backend with MongoDB for price tracking.
Designed a trust-weighted scoring scheme for crowdsourced submissions that defends against Sybil attacks, downgrading ratings of dormant accounts.
Replaced blanket verification with consensus-strength checks: validation runs only when consensus is weak, cutting verifications by up to 61%.

projects.title: Maruti Inventory Optimization
description: Consulted with managers of a multi-showroom Maruti dealership group (Navi Mumbai, Thane) to design an inventory-management application.
Researched inventory signals (stock, average consumption) and applied constraint-based logic to flag unnecessary auto-orders, preventing dead-stock accumulation.
Made effective use of AI models and agentic methods to speed up development of the project.
Used in production by dealership managers for dead-stock avoidance.

achievements: Published security research and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities on tushn.vercel.app.
Finalist, Code Craft Hackathon: built backend service and REST APIs integrating the Groq LLM API for an AI coding editor.
Ranked 3rd out of 150+ teams in the RedFox CTF as part of a 4-member team.
